rows.note: This is the all-purpose choice for making pain, difficulty, or a burden less severe.

example.english: This painkiller can alleviate the pain in my back.
example.traditional: 呢粒止痛藥可以減輕我背脊嘅痛。
example.jyutping: ne1 nap1 zi2 tung3 joek6 ho2 ji5 gaam2 heng1 ngo5 bui3 zek3 ge3 tung3

rows.note: Use this especially for pain or physical discomfort when the focus is soothing it.

example.english: A hot compress for a while can alleviate muscle tension.
example.traditional: 熱敷一陣可以舒緩肌肉繃緊。
example.jyutping: jit6 fu1 jat1 zan6 ho2 ji5 syu1 wun6 gei1 juk6 bang1 gan2

rows.note: Use this in financial contexts when the payment reduces only part of a debt.

example.english: I used this month’s pay to alleviate part of my debt.
example.traditional: 我用今個月份糧先還一部分債。
example.jyutping: ngo5 jung6 gam1 go3 jyut6 fan6 loeng4 sin1 waan4 jat1 bou6 fan6 zaai3
